card.name: Time spans and schedule wording in dosing text
card.fires_on: Time units like weeks or days after a number, and the words after or dose in phrases like 'for 1 week after the last dose'. Also commas in day lists of a cycle and the period ending a dialysis sentence.

modes.label: Time units after a number
modes.description: The unit word (weeks, days) right after a number in a duration or schedule.
modes.example: the dosage should be gradually reduced over a period of 1 to 2<< weeks>> and the patient should be carefully monitored.

modes.label: After the last dose
modes.description: Words after or dose in contraception-duration phrases that follow the final dose.
modes.example: to use effective contraception during treatment with GAVRETO and for 1 week<< after>> the last dose [see Use in Specific

modes.label: Schedule list punctuation
modes.description: A comma in a list of cycle days or a period ending a short statement.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it suppresses words about suffixes, duplicates and sorting, and promotes a few Chinese tokens.
card.plain: It lights up on the length-of-time wording in dosing schedules, such as 'for 2 weeks after the last dose'.
